text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Air Groove is totally going to win the Osaka Hai! She's on a whole different level from the other racers!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Ooh, I can't wait to be bathed in the light of the Empress today! Go, Air Groove!

text_block_list.name: Female Dober Fan
text_block_list.text: Yikes, seems like everyone is an Air Groove fan. Just focus on yourself, Dober!

text_block_list.name: Male Dober Fan
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Dober, you can do it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Have you had a good look at the stands? They're filled with Air Groove's fans. Her popularity is nothing to sneeze at.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: But well, that's just reality. I'm still a long way from the legacy I'm aiming for.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: And that's exactly why I'm going to chase after Air Groove with all I have in this race!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I have to do everything I can, even if it's only to get a little closer to my ideal!
choice_data_list: Save some of that energy for the race.
Save some of that energy for the race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: …I know. It's not like I can keep pace with Air Groove with enthusiasm alone.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: You're right. It's not like I can keep pace with Air Groove with enthusiasm alone.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Air Groove… I look forward to racing you today!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I'm expecting nothing but your best performance, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (I have to keep up with her. I can't let Air Groove down!)
